name: After § 90
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 90b. Expresses deep concern about the lack of transparency of non-governmental organisations (NGOs), especially regarding their funding; recalls ECA special report 35/2018, which highlighted the lack of transparency with regard to the implementation of EU funds by NGOs; emphasises the consequent risk of money laundering and terrorist financing through non-profit organisations; recalls ECA special report 11/2025, which highlights the fact that of more than 4 400 NGOs, 30 received more than 40 % (i.e. EUR 3.3 billion) of total funding to NGOs during the period 2014-2023, and links this with an intravenous dependence of certain NGOs on EU funding and, ultimately, with all that this implies for their activities and orientations;
